data.description: 【泥岩 · 花田拾花】莱塔尼亚郊外盛开着各色野花的宁静草坡上，换上素白连衣裙的泥岩弯下腰，小心翼翼地用粗糙但温柔的指尖摘下一朵雏菊捧在掌心。她转过身有些害羞地递给你——「大地不仅孕育了坚硬的磐石，也孕育了这么温柔的花朵……送给你，博士。」
data.promptProse: Mudrock bends toward a white daisy on the grassy wildflower slope, carefully lifting it into her palm before offering it with a shy smile. Plain white short-sleeved cotton dress and modest round neckline retain her simple outfit beneath falling silver hair and curved horns. The medium view keeps flower and hand in front of receding blooms. Afternoon sun brightens the petals and horns, with gentle grass shadows beneath her bowed posture.
data.title: 泥岩 · 花田拾花
